01 — DEFINE

Know what you’re looking for.

Start with the keywords and phrases relevant to your work: a company name, a financial term, or a requirement.

02 — HIGHLIGHT

Make the details stand out.

Bring matching language into view. The repository’s keyword format supports named profiles, colors, and enabled states.

03 — UNDERSTAND

Keep the context.

Read the surrounding passage, compare the evidence, and decide what deserves your attention. Color is a cue to look closer.

03 / Built around your attention.

Different work.
Same need for clarity.

From a disclosure to a campaign brief, the concept is simple: make relevant language easier to find.

Research & financial analysis

Bring disclosures, financial terms, and risk factors into focus while you read and compare source material.

Contracts & compliance

Look for clauses, exclusions, renewal dates, regulatory references, and exceptions. Always review the full document.

Marketing & communications

Spot brand names, competitor mentions, campaign requirements, and media references in the material you review.

People & project operations

Find role requirements, deliverables, dependencies, escalation terms, and deadlines in everyday work.
